chat:en:When should I open the windows?:
- Keep them shut now, and open them from 12:00 to 17:00 today [airing].
- Outdoor air is dirtiest overnight and during the morning rush, but it gets cleaner in the early afternoon when the ground warms up [K:airing].
chat:en:Which mask works for the school:
- A certified N95 or FFP2 mask seals around the nose and chin to block fine particles [K:mask-fit].
- Wear an N95 on the walk to school [A:mask-school-run].
- Check for air escaping at the edges and pinch the nose clip [K:mask-fit].

chat:hi:खिड़कियाँ कब खोलूँ?:

chat:hi:स्कूल जाते समय कौन-सा मास्क काम:
